title: Rain Check
logline: Stranded at a bus stop in the rain, Mei is rescued by a stranger with a red umbrella. He tells her to bring it back next time. The next morning she finds where.
style: Cinematic film still, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, teal-and-amber color grade.
avoid: No text, no captions, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
clip_audio: Dialogue and ambient sound only, no music.

mei.name: Mei
mei.look: a woman in her late 20s, East Asian, shoulder-length straight black bob with blunt bangs, small silver hoop earrings, slim build
mei.outfit: a mustard-yellow hooded raincoat over a black turtleneck
mei.voice: a calm, low female voice with dry humor

theo.name: Theo
theo.look: a man in his early 30s, Black, close-cropped hair, short neat beard, warm brown eyes, tall
theo.outfit: an olive-green field jacket over a cream cable-knit sweater

umbrella.name: The red umbrella
umbrella.look: a large red umbrella with a small white crescent-moon print and a curved wooden handle

bus_stop.look: a glass bus shelter on a rain-soaked city street at night, teal and magenta neon shop lights reflected in puddles, light rain, wet asphalt, empty street

cafe.look: a small sunlit corner cafe in the morning, wooden counter, espresso machine, potted plants, a hand-painted crescent moon and coffee cup on the window glass, warm golden light, rain-washed street outside

shots.frame: Night. Mei stands alone under the glass bus shelter, no umbrella, damp hair, arms folded against the cold, rain streaming down the glass
shots.action: Rain hammers the shelter roof; Mei glances down the empty street and exhales, her breath visible in the cold
shots.sound: heavy rain on glass, distant city traffic

shots.frame: Close-up of Mei's face under the bus shelter, raindrops on her bangs and cheeks, teal neon light on one side of her face
shots.action: A raindrop falls from her bangs; she blinks it away with a tired half-smile
shots.speaker: mei

shots.frame: Theo steps in beside Mei at the bus shelter and tilts the red umbrella over her head; Mei looks up at him, surprised
shots.action: Theo holds the red umbrella over Mei as she turns to look at him
shots.speaker: theo
shots.line: You look like you're losing a fight with the sky.

shots.frame: Close-up of Mei under the red umbrella, red light glowing on her face, Theo's shoulder blurred in the foreground
shots.action: Mei raises an eyebrow and gives a dry little smile
shots.speaker: mei

shots.frame: Mei and Theo share the red umbrella at the bus shelter, both laughing, neon reflections in the puddles at their feet
shots.action: They laugh together while rain glitters in the neon light
shots.sound: rain on the umbrella, soft laughter

shots.frame: Bright headlights of an arriving bus flood the bus shelter; Theo presses the handle of the red umbrella into Mei's hand
shots.action: Theo hands Mei the umbrella and steps back into the rain
shots.speaker: theo
shots.line: Keep it. Bring it back next time.

shots.frame: Close-up of Mei's hands holding the curved wooden handle of the red umbrella; a small paper tag tied to it shows a hand-drawn crescent moon and coffee cup
shots.action: Mei turns the paper tag over in her fingers and smiles

shots.frame: Morning sun. Mei steps into the small corner cafe holding the folded red umbrella, the crescent moon and coffee cup painted on the window behind her
shots.action: Mei walks in and looks around the cafe with a hopeful smile
shots.sound: door bell chime, espresso machine hiss, soft morning chatter

wardrobe.theo: a brown barista apron over his cream cable-knit sweater

shots.frame: Theo behind the wooden cafe counter steaming milk at the espresso machine, golden morning light
shots.action: Theo looks up from the espresso machine, surprised, and breaks into a grin
shots.speaker: theo

wardrobe.theo: a brown barista apron over his cream cable-knit sweater

shots.frame: Mei at the cafe counter slides the folded red umbrella across to Theo, who leans on the counter facing her, sunlight between them
shots.action: Mei pushes the umbrella across the counter and smiles at Theo
shots.speaker: mei
shots.line: Then I'll need a new excuse.
shots.sound: cafe murmur, a cup set down on a saucer
